in_hebrew.name: לכלאן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לכלאן הוא שם שמקורו במלחמת האדון, ומתאר איש אלוהים חזק הלוחם למען האדון. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'lach' (מלחמה) ו-'lan' (אלוהים). השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים כסמל לאמונה וכוח רוחני.

in_greek.name: Λάχλαν
in_greek.meaning: Λάχλαν, ὁ πολεμικός ἄνθρωπος τοῦ Θεοῦ
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Λάχλαν προέρχεται ἐκ τῆς λέξεως 'lach' (πόλεμος) καὶ σημαίνει 'ὁ πολεμικός ἄνθρωπος τοῦ Θεοῦ'. Ἐν τοῖς Χριστιανικοῖς κύκλοις, τὸ ὄνομα τοῦτο ἐκφράζει δύναμιν καὶ ἀφοσίωσιν εἰς τὸν Θεόν.

in_latin.name: Lachlan
in_latin.meaning: Lachlan, homo Dei fortis et bellicosus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lachlan originem trahit ex vocibus 'lach' (bellum) et 'lan' (Deus), significans hominem Dei fortem et bellicosum. In traditione Christiana, hoc nomen virum robustum et devotum Deo designat.

in_english.name: Lachlan
in_english.meaning: Lachlan means 'man of God', 'warrior of the Lord', or 'strong believer'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lachlan originates from the Gaelic-Irish term 'Lachlan', which means 'lake land' or 'fjord'. However, its Christian connotation relates to 'lach' (battle) and 'lan' (God), signifying a 'warrior of the Lord' or 'man of God'. Historically, Lachlan symbolizes spiritual strength, courage, and devotion. The name is popular among Christians, reflecting a strong and faithful personality.

Lachlan means 'to devote', and as such, it can be seen as a call to live a life fully committed to God and His purposes.
